Description: Start an Arcade Raid with !arcaderaid. Join an open raid with !joinraid; !arcaderaid also joins if one is already open.
Call heads or tails. Usage: !coinflip heads or !coinflip tails.
Challenge someone: !duel @username [type]. If omitted, choose a type within 30 seconds with !duel <type>. The opponent replies !duel accept or !duel decline.
Challenge someone: !fight @username [type]. If omitted, choose a type within 30 seconds with !fight <type>. The opponent replies !duel accept or !duel decline.
Spin the slots for Prize Tickets. Each spin costs 1 Token. Usage: !slots.
View concise balances, collection size, and game records. Usage: !stats [username]
Start game trivia, then answer A, B, C, or D in chat within 30 seconds. Usage: !trivia.
Slap another user. Usage: !slap <username>
Add Item an item to a user's inventory. Usage: !add item <item name>
Use AI to analyze the current gameplay by capturing screenshots. This is a cool one.
Awards Random Loot Items to the targeted user or active chatters.
Announce the latest Clip Rivals winner.
Use at the end of stream to post socials and Copy/pasta for raid message.
Add a quote to the Quote List. Usage: !addQuote Quote Text - <username>
Delete a quote from the Quote List. Usage: !delQuote <quote number>
Remove Item from a user's inventory. Usage: !remove item <item name>
Set Game Name. Usage: !setgame <Twitch Category>
Set Stream Title. Usage: !settitle <stream title>
Give a Shoutout to a Streamer! Usage: !so <username>
Unmute User, cause he forgot to unmute.
The bot will remind you to wash your hands.

Trigger: what game, this game?, game is this
Description: Automatically provides game details.
Cancel your pending trade. Usage: !canceltrade
Change your avatar outfit color using the numbered on-screen legend. Usage: !color <number>.
Cast a line to catch fish. You can fish once every 3 minutes. Use !fish or !cast.
View your best catches and collection. Add @username to view theirs: !fishpb [@username].
View the fishing leaderboard or check a viewer rank. Usage: !fishrank [@username].
Change your avatar hairstyle using the numbered on-screen legend. Usage: !hair <number>.
Change your avatar hair color using the numbered on-screen legend. Usage: !hcolor <number>.
Make your avatar send hearts on-screen.
Move your avatar next to another viewer. Usage: !hey <username>.
Make your avatar jump up and down on-screen.
Throw an item from your inventory at a random viewer, or target someone with @username. Usage: !throw <item name> [@username].
Offer one item in exchange for an item from another viewer. Usage: !trade @username <your item> for <their item>. They can reply !trade accept or !trade decline.
Make your on-screen avatar dance and drop peaches.
Move your avatar on-screen. Usage: !walk <pixel distance>.
Pause the current song.
Resume the current song.
Show the current song request queue.
Skip the current song.
Show the currently playing song.
Request a song by title or YouTube link. Usage: !sr <song title or URL>.
Moderator: force-add a song request by YouTube link. Usage: !srForce <YouTube URL>.
Stop the current song.
Set or adjust music volume: !volume 50, !volume +10, or !volume -10.
Vote to skip the current song. Usage: !voteskip.
Check when the next song is due to play.
Report that the current song is not the one requested. Usage: !wrongsong.
Create a clip of the last 30 seconds. It will not get a title automatically.
Share the Clip Rivals challenge link.
Post the link to my Commands List.
Post the link to my Discord server.
Check how long you have followed the channel.
Say hi and get a response from VirtualID10T!
View your inventory. Use a listed item name with !throw <item name>.
Let chat know you are lurking. Usage: !lurk.
Show the multistream link for me and my friends.
Show a random or selected quote. Search quote text with a word or @username. Usage: !quote, !quote <quote number>, !quote <search text>
Search quotes by text and list matching quote numbers. Usage: !searchquote <word or @username>
Post the links to my socials.
Post a reminder that subscriptions help produce more cool content to enjoy!
Collect a permanent Halloween treat. Use !trickortreat; one treat every 10 minutes through November 7, 2026.
Check your total Trivia Points!
Let chat know you are back. Usage: !unlurk.
Vote for a Clip Rivals clip. Usage: !vote <clip code>.
